paragraphs.text: Configurable speech-to-text provider for DeepSeek Harness (OpenAI-compatible API or a local command)
# dsh-speech-gate
A configurable speech-to-text **provider** for DeepSeek Harness.

Harness keeps recognizers behind the `speechToText` service
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-speech-t

o-text`): a registry of named providers
that a channel resolves before transcribing. This package re

gisters one or more
of them, so a host can offer a choice between a hosted model, a local whisper
se
rver and a local command without any channel knowing about it.
Two backends, one package:
| backend | what it does | good for |
| `api` | `POST {baseUrl}/audio/transcriptions` (OpenAI-compatible multipart) | hosted models, `whis

per.cpp --server`, `faster-whisper-server`, `whisper-asr-webservice` |
| `exec` | runs a command, pr

ints the transcript on stdout | `whisper-cli` or `faster-whisper` on the same machine |
| `configure
d-model` | same call as `api`, but the endpoint and key come from the model connector the Host alrea
dy has | a Host whose OpenAI/Mistral model is configured once, without pasting the secret twice |

The provider never transcodes audio: the channel already hands it canonical
16 kHz mono PCM16 WAV, w
hich is what every `speechToText` provider accepts.

ut*. A flat config

## Reusing the Host model connector (`configured-model`)

Typing the same secret twice is the main friction: the Host already holds an
OpenAI or Mistral key f

or the chat model. `backend: configured-model` reuses it —
the entry names only the transcription mo

del, and the endpoint plus the
credential name come from the table below:
| provider | endpoint | credential |

| `openai` | `https://api.openai.com/v1` | `OPENAI_API_KEY` |
| `mistral` | `https://api.mistral.ai/

v1` | `MISTRAL_API_KEY` |
| `groq` | `https://api.groq.com/openai/v1` | `GROQ_API_KEY` |
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Resolution runs once per transcription, against the providers the Host reports
through `llm.listProv

n runs once per transcription, against the providers the Host reports
through `llm.listProviders()`:

1. an explicit `provider` in the entry;
2. otherwise the model family — `voxtral-*` → mistral, `whis

e candidate list. It never guesses:
the wrong credential would quietly bill the wrong account.

A provider that the model configuration does not include is refused with
"has no model connector con

figured". `configured-openai-model` remains accepted
as the earlier OpenAI-only spelling. `baseUrl`,

`apiKeyRef`, `apiKeyEnv` and
`apiKeyFile` still override anything the table provides.
## Requirements

ured-model`: the matching model connector configured in the Host;
- for `exec`: the local binary the

the matching model connector configured in the Host;
- for `exec`: the local binary the entry names.
## Agent instructions
For an agent wiring this up on a Host, in order:
1. `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:unera/dsh-speech-gate   # or @dr-co/dsh-speech-gate fr

om npm once published`
(or `file:/path/to/checkout` while iterating).
2. In `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<pro

file>/cordis.patch.yml`, mount the service row and
insert this plugin — copy the example above. If a

bundle already inserts
`speech-to-text`, override that row (`- id: speech-to-text`) instead of
inse

rting a second one.
3. Point `defaultProvider` at one of the entry `id`s (a name that is registered,

otherwise the service fails the first call explicitly).
4. `dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config |

grep -A30 speech` to confirm the
composition, then restart the server so new plugin code loads.
5.

Verify with a canonical 16 kHz mono PCM16 WAV, e.g.
`ffmpeg -i in.ogg -ar 16000 -ac 1 -f s16le out.p

cm` plus a 44-byte header, or
by sending a voice message in a channel that feeds `speechToText`.

Troubleshooting: `speech API key is unavailable (<REF>)` means the Host has no
credential under that

name — configure the model connector or set `apiKeyRef`;
`cannot tell which provider serves model`

means two known providers are
configured and the model family is not distinctive — set `provider`.
## Configuration
| field | backend | meaning |
| `id` | both | provider identity shown to the host (default: `openai-compatible` / `local-command`)

|
| `name` | both | human-readable label |
| `location` | both | `cloud` or `host-local` |
| `langu

ages` | both | accepted language hints (default `[ru, en]`) |
| `language` | both | language sent wh

en the caller omits one |
| `baseUrl` | api | OpenAI-compatible root, without the trailing slash |
|

`model` | api, exec | model name (`{model}` is available in `args`) |
